Pip is scared to close his eyes after a scary dream. #SleepyMeadowStories Oona the owl teaches him a gentle trick: picture the ones who make him feel safe, standing right beside him — then a shadow doesn't feel so big when he's not facing it alone.

This video uses AI narration and AI-generated illustrations.

#BedtimeStory #PipTheBunny #ToddlerBedtime #NightmareHelp

settings.title: The Bunny Who Was Afraid to Dream | A Sleepy Meadow Bedtime Story
